source_packets.title: Public discussion after an energy-policy vote

evidence.claim: Public discourse concentrated on implementation risk rather than headline capacity targets.
evidence.quote: Most high-engagement comments questioned procurement transparency and grid-readiness assumptions.

evidence.claim: The strongest counter-signal was that users still framed faster renewable deployment as strategically necessary.
evidence.quote: Several comments argued that execution risk does not eliminate the need to reduce energy dependence.

evidence.claim: The official timeline emphasizes procurement acceleration and grid-connection sequencing.
evidence.quote: The implementation schedule links procurement decisions with connection-readiness milestones.
